# DFW Fractional FDE

> Gordon Burgett is a fractional AI engineer in Dallas–Fort Worth. He works with small and mid-sized businesses that have little or no IT staff, including ones whose IT provider isn't helping with AI.

Gordon Burgett is the same person as https://gordonburgett.net.

## What he does

He embeds with the business and builds the software. The working style is a forward deployed engineer. The offer to ask for is a fractional AI engineer, on retainer.

- AI-connected company knowledge bases
- Custom CRMs, including CRMs built on Notion
- AI strategy for growing revenue
- Eval help for companies building AI features
- Fixed-price starting projects: a process map, a token-spend audit, an AI phone receptionist, and a Cloudflare OS setup

Prices are not published. Ask for a quote.
